headline_marked: BNP's [[Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir set to become President]]
headline: BNP's Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir set to become President
summary: The BNP Secretary General and current Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives is likely to be the party's candidate for the presidential election.
details: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is likely to be the next President of Bangladesh. Multiple high-level BNP sources have confirmed that party chairman Tarique Rahman has finalized his nomination.

Fakhrul has reportedly signed a written consent statement to run for the office, a mandatory requirement for the nomination papers. BNP has already collected two nomination papers from the Election Commission.
The presidential election is set for August 20, with nomination papers to be filed between August 13 and 16.
a 35-year gap in contested presidential elections in Bangladesh. This election will be the first contested vote for the presidency in 35 years.

A Jamaat-led 11-party alliance has nominated Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed of the LDP as their candidate. The alliance's decision was announced by Nahid Islam, the chief whip of the seorang-party alliance.

If Mirza Fakhrul becomes President, the question of his successor as Secretary General of the BNP has emerged. He has held the position for nearly 16 years, leading the party through significant challenges and prison terms.
Potential successors for the Secretary General post include Standing Committee member Salahuddin Ahmed and Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi.
caption:

headline: Accused Don arrested in Salman Shah murder case at Dhaka airport
summary: Mohammad Ashraful Haque, known as Don, was detained by immigration police while attempting to fly to Saudi Arabia for Umrah.
details: Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, widely known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka yesterday.
He was detained while attempting to leave the country for Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah and was subsequently handed over to the CID.
The arrest follows a court directive and a request from the investigation officer to stop the accused named in the FIR from leaving Bangladesh.
The case was filed with Ramna Police Station, and the CID Dhaka Metropolitan West unit is handling the investigation.
Actor Salman Shah was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence on September 6, 1996, at the age of 25.
caption:
A major turn in a 28-year-old cold case: Accused 'Don' arrested at the airport while trying to fly abroad.

Immigration police arrested Mohammad Ashraful Haque, widely known as Don, at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka yesterday.

He was detained while attempting to leave the country for Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah and was subsequently handed over to the CID.

The arrest follows a court directive and a request from the investigation officer to stop the accused named in the FIR from leaving Bangladesh.

The case was filed with Ramna Police Station, and the CID Dhaka Metropolitan West unit is handling the investigation.

Actor Salman Shah was found dead at his Eskaton Road residence on September 6, 1996, at the age of 25.
